theme_and_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast / Performance Pro Hybrid (Functional, Flat, Accessible)

tailwind_hue_collapse.instruction: Alias `blue`, `sky`, `cyan`, `indigo`, `violet`, and `purple` in your tailwind.config.js theme.colors to this exact scale to collapse all legacy colors into the single brand accent hue.

semantic_colors_recommendation.instruction: The brand guidelines define no semantic colors. To maintain the brand's aesthetic without fighting the vibrant Core Blue, use desaturated/muted tones for semantics.

typography.instruction: These classes represent the scaled-down dashboard equivalents while preserving the weight and 0.1em tracking intent from the marketing guidelines.

component_recipes.primary_button: bg-[#19CDFF] text-[#1B1C1D] hover:bg-[#00b8f0] active:bg-[#0091ca] font-light tracking-[0.1em] rounded-md transition-colors px-4 py-2 border-none shadow-none disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed data-testid="btn-primary"
component_recipes.secondary_button: bg-[#1B1C1D] text-white hover:bg-[#393E41] font-light tracking-[0.1em] rounded-md transition-colors px-4 py-2 border-none shadow-none data-testid="btn-secondary"
component_recipes.ghost_button: bg-transparent text-[#1B1C1D] hover:bg-[#E0E0E0] dark:text-white dark:hover:bg-[#393E41] font-light tracking-[0.1em] rounded-md transition-colors px-4 py-2 data-testid="btn-ghost"
component_recipes.input: bg-white border border-[#6E7476] text-[#1B1C1D] focus:border-[#19CDFF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#19CDFF] focus:outline-none rounded-md transition-all px-3 py-2 dark:bg-[#1B1C1D] dark:border-[#E0E0E0] dark:text-white data-testid="input-field"
component_recipes.active_tab: border-b-2 border-[#19CDFF] text-[#0073a4] dark:text-[#19CDFF] font-semibold tracking-wide data-testid="tab-active"

component_recipes.badge_primary: bg-[#19CDFF] text-[#1B1C1D] px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase data-testid="badge-primary"
component_recipes.badge_secondary: bg-[#1B1C1D] text-white px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase dark:bg-[#393E41] data-testid="badge-secondary"

gradient_replacement_strategy.instruction: All existing gradients (e.g., bg-gradient-to-r) must be removed entirely.
gradient_replacement_strategy.hero_headers: Use solid bg-[#1B1C1D] (Soft Black) with #FFFFFF text and #19CDFF accents.
gradient_replacement_strategy.gradient_text: Replace with solid text-[#0073a4] in light mode, text-[#19CDFF] in dark mode.

prioritised_implementation_checklist: 1. tailwind.config.js Update: Collapse `blue`, `sky`, `cyan`, `indigo`, `violet`, and `purple` into the single brand cyan scale. Inject the 5 brand hex colors as variables.
2. Global CSS Injection: Apply the provided light/dark `--...` css custom properties in globals.css/index.css.
3. Typography Standardization: Apply `font-family: 'Proxima Nova'` globally. Update utility classes for H1-H5 across components to enforce specific letter-spacing (tracking-[0.1em]) and weights.
4. Component Refactoring (Buttons): Purge ALL `bg-blue-600 text-white` classes. Map primary buttons to `bg-[#19CDFF] text-[#1B1C1D]` and secondary to `bg-[#1B1C1D] text-white`.
5. Gradient Eradication: Search and replace `bg-gradient-*` and `bg-clip-text` utilities across the codebase. Replace with flat brand colors.
6. Chart Palette Update: Reconfigure default Recharts/ChartJS color arrays to the specific 7-color scale.
7. Automated Testing Preparation: Ensure all updated UI elements include `data-testid` attributes.
